title: Unit 10 Test
subtitle: Past Simple · regular & irregular verbs · did / didn’t · ago

sections.title: A. Write the Past Simple form.
B. Complete the sentences. Use the verb in the Past Simple.

items.q: Last night we (watch) ______ a football match.
I (meet) ______ my friends in the park.

a: I didn’t go to work yesterday
I did not go to work yesterday
We did not visit the museum
They didn’t buy a new car
They did not buy a new car

items.q: you / go / to the cinema / last weekend
a: Did you go to the cinema last weekend
Where did you go on holiday
What did they have for dinner

items.q: Did you call your mum? — Yes, I ______.
Did he pass the exam? — No, he ______.

sections.title: F. Read the text. Are the sentences true or false?
sections.passage: Last summer Shoxrux and his friend Akram went to the mountains near Chimgan. They left Tashkent early on Saturday morning and arrived at about ten. They walked for five hours and had lunch next to a river. In the afternoon it started to rain, so they stayed in a small guest house. They didn’t have a TV, but they played cards and talked all evening. On Sunday they came home by bus.

items.q: They went to the mountains in winter.
They arrived at about ten o’clock.
They had lunch next to a river.
They watched TV in the evening.
